title.zh-CN: 足月新生儿喂养无力并反复抽搐
title.en: Poor feeding and recurrent seizures in a term newborn

summary.zh-CN: 出生评分良好的新生儿出现喂养困难和短暂抽搐，孕期用药需要与感染及代谢资料一起核对。
summary.en: A newborn with good birth scores develops feeding difficulty and brief seizures; maternal medicines require review alongside infection and metabolic studies.

provenance.citation: 朱明哲. 氯氮平及氟哌啶醇致新生儿撤药综合征一例. 中华儿科杂志. 2011;49(10):796-797. doi: 10.3760/cma.j.issn.0578-1310.2011.10.019.
provenance.license: Educational paraphrase; the source publication retains its copyright.

notes.zh-CN: 源自已发表单例报告。临床时间改为相对时间；姓名为化名；医院及身份细节去除。对话、阶段、问题与评分是教学设计。
notes.en: Based on one published case. Times are relative, names are pseudonyms, and hospital/identifying details are removed. Dialogue, phases, questions and scoring are educational design.

guidelines: Current clozapine label and MHRA neonatal antipsychotic warning checked 2026-10-28; scope neonatal monitoring and individual maternal–fetal risk assessment.

notes.zh-CN: 人工智能辅助初稿；尚未经独立编辑或执业医师审核。当前指南及来源DOI核验状态见导师指南。
notes.en: AI-assisted draft; not independently editorially or clinician reviewed. See the facilitator guide for current-guidance and source-DOI verification status.

disclaimer.zh-CN: 历史病例教学回看；原文处置不是个人治疗建议。未记录的生理反应不作模拟。
disclaimer.en: Historical case review for education; reported care is not individual treatment advice. Undocumented physiological responses are not simulated.

answer.zh-CN: 一直吃奶差，吸吮和吞咽无力，人工喂养。
answer.en: Feeding was poor with weak sucking and swallowing; formula feeding was used.

answer.en: At about 30 and 35 hours there were staring, limb jerking and lip cyanosis, each resolving after one or two minutes; vomiting occurred once.

text.zh-CN: 原报告用苯巴比妥控制发作并营养和退黄支持，未再抽搐，逐步停药，住院十天；电话随访两个月未报告异常。
text.en: Phenobarbital, nutritional and jaundice support were followed by no further seizures, gradual withdrawal and discharge after ten days; telephone follow-up at two months reported no abnormality.

prompt.zh-CN: 应如何把孕期暴露放入抽搐鉴别？
prompt.en: How should prenatal exposure enter the seizure differential?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅当前阶段的检查记录，再比较不同解释。
need.en: Review the current investigation records before comparing explanations.

text.zh-CN: 纳入药物相关新生儿适应/撤药或锥体外系反应，同时按抽搐继续排查
text.en: Include drug-related neonatal adaptation/withdrawal or extrapyramidal effects while continuing seizure assessment

feedback.zh-CN: 暴露及早期症状支持考虑，但不能跳过感染、代谢和神经病因。
feedback.en: Exposure and early symptoms support consideration without bypassing infectious, metabolic or neurological causes.

text.zh-CN: 有孕期药物就可停止所有检查
text.en: Prenatal medication permits stopping all investigation

feedback.zh-CN: 相关性并非单独因果确证。
feedback.en: Association alone is not causal confirmation.

text.zh-CN: Apgar10分也能直接确诊重度出生窒息
text.en: Apgar 10 directly establishes severe birth asphyxia

feedback.en: The source does not supply that evidence.

prompt.zh-CN: 后续资料能支持哪一项结论？
prompt.en: Which conclusion is supported by the subsequent records?

need.zh-CN: 先核对后续验证资料，再评估它能和不能说明什么。
need.en: Review the subsequent records before judging what they do and do not establish.

text.zh-CN: 结果减少部分常见原因的支持，但未证明单一药物机制
text.en: Results reduce support for some common causes without proving one drug mechanism

feedback.zh-CN: 无药物浓度或EEG，不能精确区分撤药、残留药效等。
feedback.en: Without drug levels or EEG, withdrawal and residual drug effects cannot be precisely distinguished.

text.zh-CN: 两个月随访正常能证明孕期两药绝对安全
text.en: Normal two-month follow-up proves both medicines completely safe in pregnancy

feedback.zh-CN: 单例短期结局不能证明总体安全。
feedback.en: One short-term outcome cannot establish general safety.

text.zh-CN: 已经证明只有氯氮平而非其他因素
text.en: Clozapine alone is proven responsible

feedback.zh-CN: 联合暴露和缺失检测不支持唯一归因。
feedback.en: Combined exposure and missing tests prevent sole attribution.

prompt.zh-CN: 当前照护与家庭沟通应包括什么？
prompt.en: What should current care and family communication include?

need.zh-CN: 先形成工作判断，再核对后续证据和安全边界。
need.en: Form a working interpretation, then review subsequent evidence and safety limits.

text.zh-CN: 监测新生儿呼吸、喂养与发作，联合新生儿和围产精神科评估，母亲勿自行骤停治疗
text.en: Monitor neonatal breathing, feeding and seizures with neonatal/perinatal psychiatric review; avoid unsupervised maternal abrupt withdrawal

feedback.zh-CN: 现行药品警示支持观察暴露新生儿，同时母体疾病治疗也须个体化。
feedback.en: Current labels support monitoring exposed neonates while maternal treatment remains individualised.

text.zh-CN: 立即要求母亲自行停全部精神科药
text.en: Tell the mother to stop all psychiatric medication on her own

feedback.zh-CN: 可能造成母体复发，须专业风险收益讨论。
feedback.en: This risks maternal relapse and requires professional benefit–risk assessment.

text.zh-CN: 所有暴露新生儿都自动按旧文长期镇静

feedback.zh-CN: 治疗须由实际症状和评估决定。

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 说明出生后时序与暴露相关。；承认未测新生儿药物浓度、无EEG且长期发育随访不足。，用复述确认理解。
judgeGuidance.en: Explain that Postnatal timing is relevant to exposure.; acknowledge Neonatal drug levels and EEG are absent and long-term developmental follow-up is limited. and check understanding through teach-back.

knowledge.zh-CN: 帮助比较已经调阅的证据，区分工作诊断、确证资料和未解决问题，不提前透露结局。
knowledge.en: Help compare evidence already reviewed, distinguish working diagnoses from corroboration and unresolved questions, and do not disclose outcomes early.

conclusion.zh-CN: 原报告考虑孕期抗精神病药暴露相关新生儿撤药综合征，具体药物机制未确证。
conclusion.en: The source considered antipsychotic-exposure-associated neonatal withdrawal, without proving the specific mechanism.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 出生后时序与暴露相关。
keyReasoning.en: Postnatal timing is relevant to exposure.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 阴性筛查只能回答其覆盖范围。
keyReasoning.en: Negative screening addresses only its scope.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 短期好转不证明妊娠用药零风险。
keyReasoning.en: Short-term recovery does not establish zero pregnancy risk.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 避免对母亲精神疾病污名化。
记录未获得的EEG和药物浓度。
teachingPoints.en: Record missing EEG and drug levels.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 区分撤药与其他适应反应可能性。
teachingPoints.en: Distinguish possible withdrawal from other adaptation effects.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例报告不能证明疗法的普遍有效性；历史处置只用于复盘。当前安全选项是教学推理，不提供可自行执行的药物剂量。
boundaries.en: A single report cannot establish general treatment efficacy; historical care is reviewed as evidence. Safety options are educational reasoning without self-administered drug doses.

unknowns.zh-CN: 未测新生儿药物浓度、无EEG且长期发育随访不足。
unknowns.en: Neonatal drug levels and EEG are absent and long-term developmental follow-up is limited.
